text: {"lessons":["Selling part of Stock C after a strong rise locked in gains, but I should base future sales on my overall plan, not just the satisfaction of seeing a profit against my cost.","Selling Stock D and E at steep losses was painful; I should review weakening holdings before losses become so large, rather than waiting for them to recover to my cost.","My account value fell despite gains in some trades, so I should check the whole portfolio periodically and set clear reasons to buy, sell, or hold—even though I trade rarely."]}
